methodology: Reviewed the first source photograph for every idol (indices 98–332) from contact sheets sheet-5.png through sheet-17.png, with individual scrutiny for dark/chrome, matte white, painted, and darkened-relief examples. Labels describe visible finish only; existing construction is copied unchanged.
limitations: Labels describe the visible finish; lighting and processing can affect polish appearance.
Small painted eyes, lips and tilaks remain plain silver. Substantial painting is colour.
